forecasts.reason: Diagnostic with no recipe change; the seeds 0-2 numbers should land near the tip's usual 0.753 +/- 0.3 pp rebuild noise. Fresh-seed mean is likely about 0.752.
E052/E053 are already measured at 4.99 and 5.07 s. The gate with 1.64 sigma_tot is strict, so pass or fail is close to a coin flip.
E046 was measured at 5.08 s and 0.754. A dial of about 1-2 s/pp is likely, but the SE is large.
The rules likely block it, or the coarse-label gain is small. If it does run, time is unchanged and the effect is within noise.
The port already sets BN weight requires_grad=False, so this closes by reading the code. Any run would be the same as the tip.
The saving is about 0.01-0.03 s, below build noise. Accuracy change is likely within noise.
Offline diagnostic. The curves will probably order the outcomes only loosely, and group-1 and group-2 rates will not separate cleanly.

cruxes: What is the rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean on fresh seeds? If it is 0.1 pp or more, every sub-0.15 pp keep decision is noise and the 0.753 gate on 3 seeds is largely a lottery.
Is the tip's population mean on fresh seeds at least 0.751? That decides how much more margin can be spent on cuts.
Does the group-2 freeze have a cliff before 85%? E053 suggests not, so more freeze dose may still be free.
